{"script":"tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
pre="$tmpdir/precheck.txt"
entries="$tmpdir/entries_list.txt"
candidates="$tmpdir/candidates.txt"
result="$tmpdir/result_prep.txt"

# precheck
{
  echo "timestamp: $(date --iso-8601=seconds)"
  if [ -e /working ]; then
    echo "/working: exists"
    ls -ld /working 2>&1
    echo -n "access: "
    [ -r /working ] && echo -n "read "
    [ -w /working ] && echo -n "write "
    [ -x /working ] && echo -n "execute "
    echo
  else
    echo "/working: does not exist"
  fi
} >"$pre"

# enumerate entries recursively with basic metadata
if [ -e /working ]; then
  find /working -printf '%p|%y|%s|%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>"$tmpdir/find_errors.txt" >"$entries"
else
  : >"$entries"
fi

# filter candidates whose basename is exactly "workspace"
awk -F'|' '{n=$1; split(n,a,"/"); if(a[length(a)]=="workspace") print $1"|"$2}' "$entries" | sort -u >"$candidates"

# prepare result_prep.txt: state whether any candidate is a regular file and list exact paths
if [ -s "$candidates" ]; then
  awk -F'|' '$2=="f" {print $1}' "$candidates" >"$tmpdir/_regular_paths.txt"
  if [ -s "$tmpdir/_regular_paths.txt" ]; then
    echo "regular_file: yes" >"$result"
    echo "paths:" >>"$result"
    sed 's/^/ - /' "$tmpdir/_regular_paths.txt" >>"$result"
    final=yes
  else
    echo "regular_file: no" >"$result"
    final=no
  fi
else
  echo "regular_file: no" >"$result"
  final=no
fi

# ensure files are readable
chmod a+r "$pre" "$entries" "$candidates" "$result" 2>/dev/null || true

# print the temp workspace path (for inspection) and final single-word answer on separate line
echo "$tmpdir"
echo "$final""}
